_: Each trade's day, for a resident's body in its town (decisions 333 and 404): stints of {from, to, at} on DayNight's clock (hours 0-24; a stint may run over midnight), 'at' one of work, home, square, well, inn, temple; any hour no stint covers is the square, and a place the town lacks (no inn, no well, no temple standing) is the square too. A trade not listed has the default's. 'work' is where the body stands, never when economy's job runs. offset_hours: each resident's own clock runs this far ahead or behind the town's at most, by worker id, so the town never moves in lockstep. types: a hidden type's stints, over the trade's where they overlap. seasons: the day's edges move: every boundary before noon by 'morning' hours, after by 'evening'. temple: every so many days (the day by worker id), this morning hour at the temple, when the town has one. Placeholders until Jeff and economy settle each trade's day.

hearsay._: What a resident keeps of what they hear (decision 378, Hearsay): at most max claims; the newest shown believed ones reach their voice; a claims ask per resident at most every claims_ticks; a claim against what they know is believed with chance max(0, (against[0] - intellect) / against[1]), one beyond it with beyond's; a line of fewer than min_words words is never weighed.

gossip._: Decision 422: every 'every' steps, in each town, residents standing at one of 'places' (never at work or home) pass one thing between two of them: a belief, or something the teller saw. No model call.

lore_chars._: Decision 440: the voice's budget of lore facts by hidden type, in characters; a type not listed has Resident.LORE_CHARS (600).

memory._: The town memory log (the lawspeaker, phase 1): a belief becomes a candidate for town memory once spread people have held it, held still do, and it is hold_days old; max entries kept per town.

standing._: Decision 443: what a resident thinks of a player, a score moved by events (each key a step), trusted and wronged the words' thresholds, top the last word, most the score's bound, heard what gossip moves it (to heard_most at most), why_kept reasons remembered, decay_days between steps back toward 0.

offers._: Decision 435 (amended 2026-10-18, Jeff): what a resident offers when spoken to: at most max fresh offers, per_player open commissions at once, a commission lapses after days. Rule: commissions come from people and what is between them, never 'go get object A from location B'; what the town is short of is talk, and banking it pays on its own; no commission needs accepting (the event completes it, with a notice and the pay).
